headline: ChunkAct compiles agent memory into action chunks to cut planner calls in simulated robotics
summary: A new paper introduces ChunkAct, which compiles an LLM agent’s procedural memory into executable action chunks and calls the planner mainly for decisions or failures. On LIBERO-Pro simulation, the authors report 83.8% task success versus 78.8% for a matched Harness VLA baseline, with 2.9 times fewer LLM calls, 4.4 times fewer input tokens and 2.3 times fewer output tokens. On LIBERO-Plus, they report zero-shot results above previously reported VLA baselines, though those baselines were fine-tuned on that benchmark. These are paper-reported results; no physical-robot evaluation or independent reproduction was performed in this review.
